description: Orchestrate Google Colab Pro/Pro+ GPU instances as remote training backends via SSH. Compounds /agent-browser (to launch Colab sessions and install colab-ssh) with SSH (to operate the runtime remotely). Use when: (1) launching a Colab notebook for GPU training, (2) running training jobs on Colab from the local terminal, (3) transferring datasets/checkpoints to/from Colab, (4) monitoring GPU utilization on a Colab instance, (5) integrating Colab GPU compute with /autoany EGRI optimization loops, (6) reconnecting to a Colab session after timeout. Triggers on: "colab", "colab-remote", "colab ssh", "colab training", "remote GPU", "colab pro", "train on colab", "google colab".
